name: Koillection
tagline: Koillection allow you to manage any kind of collections.
description: Koillection is a self-hosted service allowing users to manage any kind of collections.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Jwt secret key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Jwt public key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Db password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  koillection:
    image: koillection/koillection:1.8.5
    container_name: koillection
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - ${APP_PORT}:80
    depends_on:
      - koillection-db
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/uploads:/uploads
    environment:
      - APP_DEBUG=0
      - APP_ENV=prod
      - HTTPS_ENABLED={APP_EXPOSED}
      - UPLOAD_MAX_FILESIZE=20M
      - PHP_MEMORY_LIMIT=512M
      - PHP_TZ=${TZ}
      - CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN=*
      - JWT_SECRET_KEY=${SECRET_JWT_SECRET_KEY}
      - JWT_PUBLIC_KEY=${SECRET_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY}
      - DB_DRIVER=pdo_pgsql
      - DB_NAME=koillection
      - DB_HOST=koillection-db
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - DB_USER={KOILLECTION_DB_USER}
      - DB_PASSWORD=${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
      - DB_VERSION=15
  koillection-db:
    image: postgres:15
    container_name: koillection-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_DB=koillection
      - POSTGRES_USER={KOILLECTION_DB_USER}
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/volumes/postgresql:/var/lib/postgresql/data
